name: application-dock
title: Dock
description: Dock and app-launcher navigation components for surfacing pinned shortcuts and primary destinations in web applications.
useWhen: Dock and app-launcher navigation components for surfacing pinned shortcuts and primary destinations in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid dock when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Dock uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
